pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-411 was wet clean wall buildup removed and new showerhead with 5 dummy wafers seasoning run, pre-PM time 61.76 s, baseline clean time 60.0 s, target 500.0 A with control 493.0 to 507.0 A and spec 485.0 to 515.0 A
Monitor 1 at 61.76 s on MET02 measured 519.99 A with implied rate 8.4195 A per s, runs since PM 1, 3 monitor wafers left
Certified reference wafer 500.0 A, MET01 reads 500.03 A and MET02 reads 499.64 A, MET02 minus MET01 -0.39 A checked 4.1 hours ago
No offset applied, rate 8.4195 A per s gives recipe 59.39 s for 500 A, change vs pre-PM -3.84 pct, pre-PM time would give 519.99 A
PM-149 was wet clean with new showerhead and 5 dummy wafers, first wafers vs later -0.42 A, slope -0.83 A per lot, mean last 10 thickness 503.18 A

release.summary: Chamber cleaned so old 61.76s now thick at 520A; single monitor confirms and seasoning means representative. New recipe 59.39s hits 500A target, -3.84% within 8% cap, no offset needed as matching is -0.39A negligible. New showerhead will thin fast like PM-149 slope -0.83A/lot so set drift 0.83 and lambda 0.4 to follow.
